test_title: PYST 56: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 13th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Two students A and B appeared in an examination. A secured 9 marks more than B and his marks were 60% of the sum of their marks. The marks obtained by A were:
solution:
**Calculation:**

Let, the marks secured by B = y

⇒ Marks secured by A = y + 9

According to the question-

⇒ y + 9 = 60over100 × (y + y + 9)

⇒ 10y + 90 = 6y + 6y + 54

⇒ 10y + 90 = 12y + 54

⇒ 2y = 36

⇒ y = 18

∴ Marks scored by A = 18 + 9 = 27

**∴ Marks obtained by A was 27.**
